name: orders_by_status
question: 各订单状态有多少订单？
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY order_count DESC, status

name: monthly_delivered_gmv
question: 每月已签收商品 GMV 是多少？
sql: SELECT substr(o.purchase_timestamp, 1, 7) AS month, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS delivered_gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

name: top_categories_by_delivered_gmv
question: 已签收 GMV 最高的五个商品类别是什么？
sql: SELECT category_name, ROUND(SUM(price), 2) AS delivered_gmv FROM product_sales WHERE order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY category_name ORDER BY delivered_gmv DESC, category_name LIMIT 5

name: average_order_value
question: 已签收订单的平均客单价是多少？
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(item_value) / COUNT(*), 2) AS average_order_value FROM order_financials WHERE status = 'delivered'

name: on_time_delivery_rate
question: 已签收订单的按时送达率是多少？
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(delivered_on_time) * 100, 4) AS on_time_delivery_pct FROM order_delivery_metrics

name: payment_value_by_type
question: 各支付方式的支付金额是多少？
sql: SELECT payment_type, ROUND(SUM(payment_value), 2) AS payment_value FROM payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY payment_value DESC, payment_type

name: repeat_customers
question: 下过两次及以上订单的消费者有多少？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_customers FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 1)

name: top_seller_states
question: 已签收 GMV 最高的五个卖家州是什么？
sql: SELECT seller_state, ROUND(SUM(price), 2) AS delivered_gmv FROM product_sales WHERE order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY seller_state ORDER BY delivered_gmv DESC, seller_state LIMIT 5
